root.label: Indian border forces kill two Pakistani civilians in Bedian sector

events.label: Indian border forces kill two Pakistani civilians in Bedian sector

slots.name: people killed
slots.sentence: “The BSF personnel resorted to unprovoked and lethal force against unarmed civilians. Such use of force was wholly unjustified and grossly disproportionate, resulting in the tragic loss of two precious lives,” it said.

events.label: Pakistan summons Indian diplomat over border killing

slots.name: people killed
slots.sentence: Pakistan’s Foreign Ministry says it has summoned India’s charge d’affaires to strongly protest the killing of two Pakistani civilians by Indian border troops.
